summary: Mandatory post-fix retest completed on local Node22 OpenNext worker (http://127.0.0.1:8787). Backend regression suites for iteration-160 and iteration-161 passed, rapid home→products→detail→compare→contact loops passed functionally, but strict zero-failure network gate still fails due recurring _rsc net::ERR_ABORTED and fallback /api/track net::ERR_ABORTED during navigation-heavy flows.

integration_issues.flow: Rapid navigation gate (home → products → detail → compare → contact, repeated)
integration_issues.issue: Observed 7 requestfailed events for _rsc URLs (net::ERR_ABORTED) across 3 rapid loops; strict requirement of zero failed _rsc requests is not met.

integration_issues.flow: Analytics fallback transport verification (sendBeacon forced off)
integration_issues.issue: Fallback instrumentation captured valid analytics payloads, but 6 /api/track requests still failed with net::ERR_ABORTED under navigation/interactions; strict zero-failure /api/track requirement is not met in fallback mode.

action_items: Eliminate _rsc request abort noise during rapid client transitions (current gate still logs net::ERR_ABORTED despite SafeLink rollout).
Harden /api/track fallback transport path against cancellation during route transitions so fallback mode also reaches zero requestfailed entries.
Re-run strict rapid-navigation gate and require: failed_rsc=0, failed_track=0, console_errors=0 in both default and fallback analytics paths.
critical_code_review_comments: No MOCKED APIs were used; all checks were executed against local worker endpoints only.
Code scan confirms next/link imports are centralized through SafeLink (no direct next/link imports remain outside safe-link.tsx).
Idle/speculative prefetch check did not observe background _rsc requests while idle (idle_rsc=0), so remaining _rsc failures appear tied to in-flight navigation cancellation under rapid transitions.
Analytics payload quality is good in fallback capture (page_view + interaction events present, no obvious PII keys/values), but transport reliability under rapid transitions remains the blocker.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (functional and regression flows passed; strict network-failure gate failed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-160 backend regression remains green. Rapid UI loops are functionally stable and zero console runtime errors were observed. Remaining blocker is strict requestfailed gate: _rsc aborts persist in rapid navigation, and fallback-mode analytics still shows /api/track aborts. Fallback payload capture confirms page_view + interaction events and no PII/duplicate pageviews.
rca of the issue: RCA: Failures are cancellation-type transport aborts (net::ERR_ABORTED), not API 500/hydration crashes. Repro: rapidly loop home→products→detail→compare→contact; observe aborted _rsc requests. With sendBeacon disabled for fallback inspection, /api/track requests also abort during transition-heavy phases. Mitigation direction: make analytics fallback dispatch cancellation-resilient and further reduce/collapse in-flight route fetch churn during rapid navigations.
